dials.label: Calmer
dials.plain: Slows motion, softens the type hierarchy and adds room, so the page feels quieter and less urgent. Opposite of dial:louder.

dials.label: Louder
dials.plain: Speeds motion up, widens the gaps between heading sizes and tightens space, so the page feels bolder and more insistent. Opposite of dial:calmer.

dials.label: Denser
dials.plain: Fits more on screen: smaller body text, tighter lines and tighter spacing. Good for tools and tables. Opposite of dial:airier.

dials.label: Airier
dials.plain: Gives everything more room: larger body text, looser lines and wider spacing. Good for reading and marketing pages. Opposite of dial:denser.

dials.label: Softer
dials.plain: Rounds corners, eases motion at both ends and loosens lines, for a friendlier feel. Opposite of dial:sharper.

dials.label: Sharper
dials.plain: Squares corners, makes motion snap and tightens lines, for a precise, technical feel. Opposite of dial:softer.

dials.label: Quicker
dials.plain: Shortens every transition by a quarter and uses the snappy standard curve. Opposite of dial:slower.

dials.label: Slower
dials.plain: Lengthens every transition by a third and uses the gentle curve. Reduced-motion visitors are unaffected. Opposite of dial:quicker.
